title: Mobility and insurance while you buy a car
intro: Soft CTAs for car-sharing if you want to delay ownership, and insurance comparison when you are ready to cover a car. Confirm live prices and cover on official sites — this block is not a ranking of dealers, workshops or municipalities.

items.reason: Car sharing for occasional trips while you decide whether ownership is worth it — often useful before a full purchase.
Compare Dutch car insurance options when you are ready to insure — verify cover, excess and exclusions yourself.
